paper.title: Agentic AI's OODA Loop Problem
paper.finding: Agents running Observe → Orient → Decide → Act loops at machine speed without an explicit validator between Decide and Act don't compound value — they compound error. The fix is a slow, explicit, validating layer that sits between the decision and the action.

response.title: Five mandatory gates. AND-combined. No fast-loop bypass.

gates.name: Budget gate

diagram.caption: Observe, Orient, and Decide remain at machine speed. The Quality Gates layer slows just enough to verify groundedness, calibration, brand, authority, and budget — then Act fires. Failures route back to learning, never to the world.

faqs.q: How do I onboard my property?
faqs.a: Sign up for Mwanzo (free) or Mkulima. Upload your Individual Landlord / Portfolio Landlord certificate and a recent rent receipt. Mr. Mwikila takes you through the first-week brief. For Mfanyabiashara and above, a BossNyumba engineer schedules an onboarding call within two business days.

faqs.q: Can I import my existing spreadsheets?
faqs.a: Yes. Rent rolls, payroll runs, treasury statements and lease calendars import via a guided CSV / XLSX flow. Master Brain validates as you go and flags any rows that need review before they enter the ledger.

faqs.q: What languages does the platform support?

securityPage.heading: BossNyumba is engineered for regulator scrutiny.
securityPage.sub: A 5-layer security model, audit-hash provenance on every artefact, and Tanzania-regional residency. Built for BOT, Regulator and NHC, and aligned with ISO 27001 controls.
securityPage.pillarsHeading: Four pillars of the BossNyumba security posture.

pillars.title: Encryption everywhere
pillars.body: AES-256-GCM at rest. TLS 1.3 in transit. Application-layer envelope encryption for high-sensitivity fields (NIDA, biometric templates, rent receipts).

pillars.title: Access on a need-to-know basis
pillars.body: Row-level security forced on every tenant-scoped table. Four-eye and sovereign-policy gates on every high-risk action. Mwikila Auditor logs every override.

pillars.title: Immutable audit chain
pillars.body: Every regulatory artefact (licence, rent, return, HSE report) is hash-chained and append-only. Tampering is detected and refused at write-time.

pillars.title: Tanzania-regional residency
pillars.body: Primary storage in Tanzania, regulator-approved failover. Sub-processors and storage regions documented at /legal/subprocessors.

securityPage.auditBody: BossNyumba writes a signed, hash-chained record for every action that touches the ledger, the licence calendar, the rent pipeline or the HSE feed. The chain is append-only at the database layer, mirrored to cold storage hourly, and exposed read-only to the regulator on request.
securityPage.ctaSub: Bring your audit checklist. We answer every line, on paper, with cited controls.
